_why: Third rung on gcd/gf180mcuD. The one remaining violation is max fanout 11 > 10 on clkbuf_2_3__f_clk/Z (a clkbuf_16); the final netlist shows its net clknet_2_3__leaf_clk drives eleven dffq CLK pins directly, so it is a leaf cluster, and CTS_SINK_CLUSTERING_SIZE 10 (confirmed in resolved.json) still produced a cluster of eleven — TritonCTS treats the size as a target it balances around, not a cap. Two candidates, one variable each: a smaller cluster target (8), and the constraint itself relaxed to 12. The second is deliberately on the ladder because MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT is OpenLane's default design rule, not a PDK rule; eleven flop clock pins on a 16x clock buffer pass every slew and cap check the run makes.
